cover.title: GTA 6: not enough space?
cover.subtitle: It needs up to 212 GB. Fix it in 5 minutes

tips.title: Find the space hogs
tips.text: PS5: Settings > Storage > Games and Apps, sort by size. Xbox: My games & apps > Manage > Storage.

tips.title: Delete, don't lose
tips.text: Turn on cloud saves first, then delete games you finished. You can download them again later.

tips.title: Clear old clips
tips.text: Old captures, screenshots and extra language packs add up fast.

tips.title: Park games on USB
tips.text: Both consoles can store games on a USB drive. Move them back to play; it's faster than re-downloading.

tips.title: Still full? Upgrade
tips.text: PS5: add an M.2 NVMe SSD (PCIe Gen4) with a heatsink. Xbox: an official storage expansion card. Picks: link in bio.
